title: AI Music Prompt & Lyrics Dataset (Suno + Udio)
subtitle: Structured prompts and lyrics for high-quality AI music generation
description:
This dataset contains structured music generation prompts and lyrics designed for use with AI music models such as Suno and Udio.

It includes genre-specific prompt templates, beat descriptions, vocal performance instructions, song structures, and fully written lyrics.

The dataset focuses on high-intensity genres such as deathcore, trap, drill, and experimental styles, with detailed attributes including tempo and rhythm patterns, vocal styles, instrumentation, song structures, emotional tone, and AI-optimized prompt formatting for consistent generation results.

All lyrics in this starter dataset are original example content created for prompt engineering, training experiments, and automated music-generation workflows.
